prompt:

Image 1 is the existing SD explorer modular body atlas: preserve its dark outlines, crisp pixel clusters, warm brown/teal/olive adventure palette, right-facing three-quarter view and compact SD proportions.
Create a new transparent atlas with SIX separately floating equipment pieces, two columns and three rows. Each item has ample transparent gaps from every other item. No character or skin/body drawn.

Row 1 right: an OLIVE CANVAS BACKPACK, seen on the far/back left side of a character facing right, simple tan straps and small outer pocket, no torso/arms.
Row 2 left: one FAR LEFT BROWN FINGERLESS GLOVE, only glove exterior, transparent finger openings, fits the left hand in Image 1.
Row 2 right: one NEAR RIGHT BROWN FINGERLESS GLOVE, only glove exterior, transparent finger openings, fits the right hand in Image 1.
Row 3 left: a small WARM OCHRE NECK SCARF tied to the side, only scarf, no head/torso.
Row 3 right: one pair of ROUND EXPLORER GLASSES, right-facing three-quarter perspective with far lens narrower, hollow transparent lenses, dark brown thin pixel outlines, no face/eyes.
Exactly these six items, one per position. No text, labels, grid lines, duplicates, limbs or background. Crisp limited flat shading, matching source pixel art. Transparent RGBA background.
